about: The playthrough's second leg, from the save the first left in Elm's lab: out of the lab, home, where the mother gives the Pokegear, west out of New Bark Town onto Route 29 -- whose music plays -- and across it to Cherrygrove City, where the guide gent shows the town and gives the running shoes; into the Pokemon Center, to the nurse, and the game is saved there. The path the navigator plans meets no wild Pokemon on this tree; the field's RNG is pinned once the field is up and the battles' seed is held, so whatever the grass sends on a later one is the same every run, and the starter fights it alone.
